Description

PGE2 acting on the EP1 receptor and histamine acting on the H1 receptor are both Gq-coupled on sensory neurons, activating PLCβ to generate IP3 and diacylglycerol and to raise intracellular Ca2+ and PKC activity. This PKC pathway sensitises TRPV1 and contributes to peripheral heat and mechanical sensitisation. H1 involvement in OA rests mainly on epidemiological evidence that antihistamine users show lower knee OA prevalence, so the direct neuronal H1 contribution to OA pain remains open.
